title: Finance Assistant
description:
We are partnering with a well-established organisation based in Portsmouth, seeking a detail-oriented Finance Assistant to join their team on an interim basis for 3-6 months. Known for their professional culture, this company supports its staff with a positive environment, with an impressive staff tenure. Operating from a modern office, this temporary role offers the chance to develop your skills within a well-established team and contribute to smooth financial operations.

What will the Finance Assistant role involve?
- Supporting daily financial processes across the department, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
- Assisting with invoice processing, client billing, and supplier reconciliations.
- Maintaining comprehensive financial records and documentation.
- Supporting timesheet entry and expense processing
- Collaborating with the finance team to support varied ad hoc tasks to keep processes running efficiently.

Suitable Candidate for the Finance Assistant vacancy:
- Experienced in a Finance Assistant role, with strong organisational skills.
- Confident in handling financial data, spreadsheets, and documentation.
- Detail-focused with a high degree of accuracy and numeracy.
- Capable of managing multiple tasks independently and prioritising effectively.
- Proactive team player with excellent communication skills.

Additional benefits and information for the role of Finance Assistant:
- Opportunities to develop your finance skills and knowledge.
- Supportive team environment with a collaborative approach.
- Flexible working hours
- Salary will be dependent on experience.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant

Portsmouth Naval Base

I'm currently recruiting for an organised and proactive HR Assistant to join a busy HR team based at Portsmouth Naval Base. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills who is looking to build on their HR experience within a fast-paced, multi-site environment.

This role is heavily focused on HR administration, supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the HR function and ensuring employee records, systems, and processes are maintained accurately and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to HR Advisors across multiple locations.
- Maintain employee records, personnel files, and HR systems, ensuring accuracy and GDPR compliance.
- Prepare and issue employment contracts, offer letters, onboarding packs, and other HR documentation.
- Support onboarding and offboarding activities to deliver a seamless employee experience.
- Manage HR databases and ensure all employee information is up to date.
- Produce regular and ad hoc HR reports, including headcount, absence, and turnover data.
- Monitor key HR deadlines, tracking employee lifecycle activities and ensuring actions are completed on time.
- Manage the HR inbox and respond to employee queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Support recruitment administration, including interview coordination, candidate communication, offer preparation, and pre-employment checks.
- Prepare documentation for employee relations processes, including absence management, disciplinary, and grievance cases.
- Take notes during meetings where required and ensure all documentation is stored appropriately.
- Organise meetings, training sessions, and HR-related events.
- Assist with HR projects and process improvement initiatives.

About You

We're looking for someone who thrives in an administration-focused environment and takes pride in delivering a high-quality service.

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Previous experience within an HR Administration, HR Assistant, or administrative support role.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
- Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information professionally.

Desirable:
- Experience working within a multi-site organisation.
- Familiarity with HR systems or HRIS platforms.
- Understanding of HR processes and employment legislation.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive HR team where you'll gain exposure to the full employee lifecycle while playing a vital role in ensuring HR operations run smoothly. If you're an organised administrator looking to further develop your HR career in a varied and rewarding position, I'd be keen to speak with you.

Interested? Apply today or contact me for a confidential discussion.
